description: Federal Housing Administration Insured Single Family Properties in Force is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri U.S. Federal Datasets. Federal Housing Administration Insured Single Family Properties In Force This National Geospatial Data Asset (NGDA) dataset, shared as a Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) feature layer, displays the outstanding balance of all active mortgage loans aggregated to the 2010 U.S. Census Tract geography. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri U.S. Federal Datasets. Its keywords are Federal, HUD, Department of Housing and Urban Development, public housing, properties, housing, insured, single family. The bounding box given is -179.1473,17.8813,179.7785,71.3905. The hub shows 2025-05-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
